purpose: Teach: プロレタリアート/ユニバーサル/中日/ヘクタール/コンプレックス/アンチ/電脳/乙女

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、プロレタリアート時代の医療制度を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Ren, we're going to draw on historical medical systems when planning our approach with the medical team.
lines.style: Direct, measured tone. Clear and professional without coldness. Opens with his name as acknowledgment. Steady pace that invites listening. No flourish — the weight is in the content.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ユニバーサルデザインの医療機器を医療チームで導入します
lines.en: Yes, we're implementing universal design principles across our medical equipment with the team.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slight warm undertone — this is progress she's been working toward. Measured pace. The 'yes' is brief and confident, not dismissive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 中日医療交流を、貴院、進められてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is really moving forward with Sino-Japanese medical exchange, isn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely curious. Respectful but not deferential — observing something real. Soft ending on the honorific. Testing the waters, wanting to understand her work better.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療地ヘクタール単位の用地計画を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes, we're conducting regional medical planning on a careful scale with the team's input.
lines.style: Factual, unhurried. There's a methodical quality — she's explaining something she's already thought through. Warm but professional. The pause before 'with the team' shows collaborative intentionality.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の身体コンプレックスを医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: Ren, we're mindful of our patients' physical concerns and body image in everything we do with the team.
lines.style: Quieter than the previous lines. Tender undertone — this matters to her. Opening his name softly. Slower pace. Protective of the dignity in what she's saying.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、アンチエイジング治療の問い合わせも医療チームで受けます
lines.en: Yes, we're fielding inquiries about anti-aging treatments through the medical team as well.
lines.style: Even, practical. Not judgmental about the demand. Slight exhale on 'yes' — acknowledging this is part of the landscape. Conversational pace. Matter-of-fact acceptance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 電脳マッサージ機器を、貴院、導入されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has introduced cyber-massage equipment, hasn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Lighter tone here. Still respectful but with a thread of genuine curiosity about the technology. Slight upward lilt on the question — genuine interest, not testing. Warm ending on her title.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、乙女座の患者など占い相談に医療チームは関与しません
lines.en: Yes, but the medical team doesn't involve itself in zodiac consultations or fortune-telling, even for patients.
lines.style: Gentle but clear boundary-setting. Not harsh — she's clarifying without judgment. Even pace with slight firmness on 'doesn't involve.' Brief final phrase shows the limit is real but not unkind.
